patches.name: Attributed copy fallback
patches.description: Keeps permitted copies unchanged. When copying is blocked, enables copying with the book title, authors and a Play Books link appended.

patches.name: Custom reader font
patches.description: Replaces the fonts of the EPUB reader with a TTF/OTF you pick on the device (Settings > Ebook reading > Custom font, or open/share a font file with Play Books). Optionally forces it over publisher fonts while keeping bold, italic and monospace text.

options.description: Also adds a "Books 글꼴" launcher icon. The font settings are always available in Play Books under Settings > Ebook reading > Custom font.
Optional path to a TTF/OTF file to embed in the APK. It is used until a font is picked on the device.

patches.name: GmsCore account type (extended)
patches.description: Experimental. Also rewrites the remaining Account(name, "com.google") constructions of the app (uploads, collections, support pages, background sync) to the GmsCore account type. "GmsCore support" alone was verified to sign in and open the library.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Lets a re-signed Play Books sign in through GmsCore (ReVanced GmsCore / microG) without root. Only the account, token and account picker paths are redirected; every other Google Play services API keeps talking to the installed Play services.

options.description: Prefix of the GmsCore build to use. The GmsCore package is <vendor>.android.gms and its account type is <vendor>.
SHA-1 certificate digest GmsCore reports to Google for OAuth.
